challenges.code:
numbers = list(range(1, 11))
print('Numbers:', numbers)

evens = [n for n in numbers if n % 2 == 0]
print('Evens:', evens)

squares = [n ** 2 for n in evens]
print('Squares:', squares)

total = sum(squares)
print('Sum of squares of evens:', total)
